antes.provinciadevelez-2026: Alex doesn't go to school and spends his day hanging around, seemingly free, doing what he was told not to do; Steven tries to hold down a job, but there's always a friend, a party, a problem; Kevin wants to escape the drugs and violence. Three young men face the harshness of Bogotá life while they wait, amid continuous failures, for a miracle.
